arguments.value: George H. Wu is a United States District Judge for the Central District of California, taking senior status in 2023. Born in New York City in 1950, he earned his B.A. from Pomona College in 1972 and his J.D. from the University of Chicago Law School in 1975. He began his legal career in private practice and as a law clerk to Judge Stanley N. Barnes of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, later serving as an assistant professor at the University of Tennessee College of Law and as an assistant U.S. attorney in the Central District of California. Wu also served on the Los Angeles Municipal Court and the Los Angeles County Superior Court before being nominated by President George W. Bush in 2007 and confirmed to the federal bench.
